d:
Nice to translate something longer every once in a while. Still no Loli-babaa tag sadly. Adding "grandma", "incest", and "inseki" because that's the core conflict of this story involving a human-eating youkai adopting a human baby.

A "Yamainu" is a type of Mountain hound youkai that's most similar to a wolf. So I'm also adding the wolfgirl tag. It's either that or monster-girl.
n: [Manga] [Toriburi] Toaru Yama no Kaii ni Tsuite | The Supernatural Anomaly of a Certain Mountain (Towako 20) [English] {Mistvern} [Digital]
